tagline: Waveshaping distortion with five curves and a tone filter
description: A waveshaper with five transfer curves, drive up to 11x, dry/wet mix, a low-pass tone filter and output gain. A display draws the selected curve, and a 20 Hz high-pass removes DC from the output.

features.name: Five shapes
features.description: Soft Clip, Hard Clip, Tanh, Cubic and Asymmetric

features.name: Drive
features.description: 0% to 100%, multiplying the input by 1x to 11x before shaping

features.name: Curve display
features.description: Draws the selected transfer curve and redraws when you change the shape

features.name: Tone
features.description: 12 dB/octave low-pass from 500 Hz to 20 kHz after the shaper; off at 100%

features.name: Output and meters
features.description: Output gain -12 dB to +12 dB, with input and output peak readouts updated 30 times a second

useCases: Gentle saturation - Soft Clip with low drive (10-30%)
Hard digital clipping - Hard Clip with high drive
Smooth saturation - Tanh with medium drive (40-60%)
Even-harmonic colour - Asymmetric mode, where the two halves of the wave clip differently
Darker distortion - lower Tone to roll off the highs the shaper adds

algorithms.name: Soft Clip
algorithms.description: Straight below 1.0, then bends over smoothly toward ±1.5, meeting the straight part with the same slope

algorithms.name: Cubic Waveshaping
algorithms.description: x - x³/3, which adds odd harmonics; past |x| = 1 the curve turns back down, so high drive folds the wave

algorithms.name: Asymmetric Waveshaping
algorithms.description: Different curves for positive and negative halves, which adds even harmonics
algorithms.code:
if (input > 0.0)
    return tanh(input * 1.5) * 0.85;  // Harder positive
else
    return tanh(input * 0.8) * 0.95;  // Softer negative
